setting: school, park, and Mio's home across cold late-autumn days; practical layered clothes outdoors

sentences.english: Tom and I are good friends, and we are similar in many ways.
sentences.japanese: トムとわたしは仲良しで、いろいろなところが似ています。

sentences.english: When we measured our heights, I was almost as tall as Tom.
sentences.japanese: 身長を測ってみると、わたしはトムとほぼ同じくらいの高さでした。

sentences.english: When we ran a race in the park, we ran almost as fast as each other.
sentences.japanese: 公園で競走してみたら、走る速さもほぼ同じくらい。

sentences.english: When I lifted his bag, it was as heavy as mine.
sentences.japanese: トムのかばんを持ち上げてみたら、わたしのと同じくらい重かった。

sentences.english: It must be full of books.
sentences.japanese: きっと中には本がたくさん入っているんでしょう。

sentences.english: Today was as cold as yesterday.
sentences.japanese: 今日は昨日と同じくらい寒かった。

sentences.english: For me, reading books is as fun as watching TV.
sentences.japanese: わたしにとって、本を読むのはテレビを見るのと同じくらい楽しいこと。

sentences.english: But I am not so good at math.
sentences.japanese: ただ、数学はちょっと苦手。

sentences.english: Math is not as easy as English for me.
sentences.japanese: わたしには数学は英語ほど簡単じゃありません。
